gaps: Existing Gladly APIs expose raw support operations endpoints; this print packages command discovery, agent defaults, local sync/search, SQL analytics, and MCP access.
patterns: Customer support workflows benefit from compact JSON, --agent defaults, local SQLite mirrors, deterministic command discovery, and read-first MCP tools.

novel_features.name: Local SQLite mirror
novel_features.description: Sync read endpoints into a local SQLite store for offline search, joins, and repeatable agent analysis.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

novel_features.name: Full-text search across API data
novel_features.description: Search live or locally synced Gladly records from one agent-friendly command.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

novel_features.name: SQL analytics on synced records
novel_features.description: Run read-only SQL against the local store for compound questions the upstream API does not expose directly.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

narrative.headline: Gladly read workflows for agents that need support operations context.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps Gladly read APIs with agent defaults, local SQLite sync, search, analytics, command discovery, and MCP tools so agents can inspect agents, conversations, conversation items, inboxes, topics, answers, reports, and tasks without hand-building HTTP calls.
